Chapter 1006: 18 Befuddled Lord Qingfen (Seeking Subscriptions)

Chapter 1006: Chapter 18 Befuddled Lord Qingfen (Seeking Subscriptions)

The Chaos Void is boundless, nurturing countless universes.

Each universe is equivalent to a Chaos Venerable in scale.

Within a universe, the will of its Origin Source reigns supreme. A Path Splitting Realm peak entity can easily suppress others. Even if a Master-level lifeform emerges, it cannot compete with the consciousness of the universe’s Origin Source.

Inside a universe, it is like the home turf of a Chaos Venerable. What can an ordinary Master-level lifeform use to resist it?

Yet just now, the Galaxy Supreme erupted with power surpassing the Path Splitting Realm peak, and the consciousness of the universe’s Origin Source not only refrained from suppressing but retreated on its own?

The two Robber Clan Ultimates did not think this was the kindness of the Origin Source consciousness. The consciousness of the Origin Source inherently lacks emotions like ‘kindness.’

The only reason the Origin Source consciousness would make such a decision can only be that it believes suppressing the Galaxy Supreme is ‘not worth it.’

“Chaos Realm… Did the Galaxy Supreme cross into the Chaos Realm?”

The voice of the Robber Clan Ultimate inside the wooden cabin trembled noticeably. Even though they had long theorized that the Galaxy Supreme might be the reincarnation of a Great Saint.

But this cultivation speed is simply too fast!

From the birth of the Galaxy Supreme to the present, in only about a millennium, they’ve directly grown to the Chaos Realm?

“Even if not Chaos Realm, the Galaxy Supreme’s strength is infinitely close to the Chaos Realm. At the very least, they could challenge a Venerable, or else the Origin Source consciousness would not retreat like this.”

The Robber Clan Ultimate outside the wooden cabin spoke in a hushed tone.

Even within the universe, trying to suppress a Chaos Venerable requires monumental effort and might even precipitate an early arrival of the Great Destruction.

“The Galaxy Supreme… Who exactly is this Galaxy Supreme the reincarnation of, among the peerless Great Saints?” The Robber Clan Ultimate inside the cabin steadied himself, unable to suppress his curiosity.

Even as a reincarnation of a Great Saint, crossing into the Chaos Realm so quickly is an almost impossible feat. After Great Saints reincarnate, their comprehension of laws and spiritual will won’t pose barriers.

But realm breakthroughs aren’t achieved solely through law comprehension and spiritual will. The physical body and soul must keep pace as well.

Even if one possesses the law comprehension of a Great Saint, if their physical body remains that of an ordinary mortal, they wouldn’t match up against a Path Splitting Realm lifeform.

“Rather than wondering which Great Saint reincarnated as the Galaxy Supreme, I’m more curious about why the Galaxy Supreme chose to reincarnate.” The Robber Clan Ultimate outside the cabin echoed the intrigue.

At the critical moment, they had made the right decision by swiftly forging an amicable relationship with the Galaxy Supreme, allowing them to peacefully observe and discuss now.

“Indeed, why would such a formidable lifeform choose to reincarnate?” The Robber Clan Ultimate inside the cabin also expressed doubts.

Reincarnation means starting anew, wiping away portions of memory. Even a peerless Great Saint would bear certain risks in reincarnation.

Without an extraordinarily compelling reason, no Great Saint would willingly reincarnate.

…

The Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Lin Yuan’s figure appeared.

“After mastering the second layer of ‘Infinite Void,’ the universe within me underwent a significant transformation, raising the limits of my physical body and soul yet again.”

Lin Yuan carefully sensed himself, thinking inwardly.

A powerful physical body and soul would birth an equally powerful internal universe.

Conversely, a sufficiently powerful internal universe would nourish back the physical body and soul.

Physical body, soul, and internal universe are intrinsically one, constituting a complementary relationship.

“The timeframe for me to cross into the Master Realm now appears to be around eighteen hundred years,” Lin Yuan estimated in his mind.

The hardest part of breaking from Path Splitting Realm to the Master Realm is comprehending the Space-Time Rule to the Seventh Realm and expanding the internal universe to a radius of one million light-years.

These requirements had long been achieved by Lin Yuan.

What held Lin Yuan back from advancing past Path Splitting Realm was instead the lack of his physical body and soul reaching their limits.

A typical Path Splitting Realm peak lifeform, having lived long enough, would have long surpassed the limits of their body and soul.

But Lin Yuan’s strength advanced too quickly, and his lifespan remained too short. His physical body and soul had incredibly high limits, and this simplest of requirements in turn restricted his progress into the Master Realm.

“Eighteen hundred years—it’s not long.”

Lin Yuan shook his head. If not for mastering the second layer of ‘Infinite Void,’ allowing the internal universe to evolve and provide immense nourishment to his physical body and soul.

Otherwise, based on Lin Yuan’s own projections, his physical body and soul might take five or six thousand years to reach their limits.

…

‘Infinite Void’ Second Layer… Lin Yuan began deducing further.

The First Layer of ‘Infinite Void’ had already yielded substantial benefits, and the advantages brought by a solid foundation were too great. Naturally, Lin Yuan aimed to progress further in this inheritance.

“The Second Layer of ‘Infinite Void’—would its enhancement of the internal universe approach the level of a Chaos Great Saint?”

Lin Yuan’s heart tinged with a trace of marvel.

If that truly were the case, mastering the Second Layer might enable him to crush ordinary Chaos Venerables.

“Hmm?”

“The life essence required for the Second Layer of ‘Infinite Void’… Seems it necessitates at least the Master Realm for me to reach?”

Lin Yuan continued browsing, his expression showing slight regret.

Without a sufficient depth of life essence, one couldn’t sustain the incomparably robust internal universe required.

“It seems I’ll have to step into the Master Realm first.”

Lin Yuan thought inwardly. As of now, all of his aspects were entrenched in bottlenecks—without reaching the Master Realm, his strength would struggle to undergo substantial qualitative changes.

…

The Fang Yuan World, Qingfen City, Sky Burning Court.

Sky Burning Court was ostensibly a courtyard, but its main structure was a thirteen-story pagoda.

Three centuries in the Main Universe equated to merely one year within the Fang Yuan World.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged in the pagoda, voraciously absorbing an array of inheritance scriptures.

These inheritance scriptures were amassed over countless years by Lord Qingfen, nearly exhaustive in scope, even encompassing cultivation methodologies from other Ancient Countries.

[Your perception transcends boundaries—reading inheritance scriptures, you intuit the essence of corresponding paths…]

By perusing an untold number of inheritance texts, Lin Yuan gradually sensed the boundless wisdom and myriad paths embedded within them.

This Fang Yuan World had an entirely distinct operational framework of rules compared to the Chaos Void—even for similar rules of fire, their manifestations diverged radically.

If Lin Yuan were left to slowly comprehend, it would waste immense time as he’d have to meticulously discern the nuances of these rules.

Yet by reading these inheritance texts? By mapping them onto the myriad inheritance scriptures from the Chaos Void, Lin Yuan’s comprehension of the Fang Yuan World’s principles shot up rapidly.

Over the course of a year, aside from reading countless inheritance texts, Lin Yuan hadn’t slacked—he’d also managed to condense nearly eight thousand Seeds of the Fierce Sun.

Condensing Seeds of the Fierce Sun required little effort and concentration for Lin Yuan, allowing him to multitask efficiently.

Additionally, his recovery and adaptation along the Martial Arts Evolution Road proceeded in parallel with the seed condensation.

“In essence, inheritance scriptures translate the universe’s grand Tao into a more comprehensible format.”

“The rules governing this Fang Yuan World’s Tao are no less intricate than those of the Chaos Void. If I can fully comprehend them, their benefits will be immeasurable.”

Lin Yuan extended a hand toward a fallen leaf, which appeared crisp and green, inscribed with insights into a pathway brimming with eternal vitality.

“In this Fang Yuan World, Great Lords correspond to Venerables of the Chaos Void, while Heavenly Venerates align with Great Saints…”

“Typically, any powerhouse hailed as a ‘Marquis’ by the Fierce Sun Ancient Country has reached the Great Lord level, while those titled as ‘King’ are on par with Heavenly Venerates.”

Lin Yuan’s mind conjured copious information—Lord Qingfen was indeed a Great Lord, albeit a peak-level Great Lord who was dangerously close to the Heavenly Venerate level.

“Powerhouses at the Great Lord level generally use Chaos Rules to give birth to their own individual Tao. In this regard, they surpass Venerables of the Chaos Void.”

Lin Yuan mused silently.

All Tao and rules originate from Chaos, and Chaos itself can birth myriad Tao. For instance, Lord Qingfen wielded his cyan flames—could they possibly be ordinary flames?

Those were born of Chaos Rules: Chaos Flame, capable even of effortlessly incinerating space-time.

“Yet the powerhouses of this Fang Yuan World tend to have comparatively weaker foundations due to their lack of support from internal universes.”

By reading these countless inheritance scriptures, Lin Yuan discerned the strengths and weaknesses between these two dimensions of the universe.

Thanks to the Seeds of the Fierce Sun, the lives of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country exceeded their counterparts in the Chaos Void in rule comprehension by a significant margin. Thus, they more readily birthed Chaos Rules and explored them further.

For instance, the technique of using Chaos Rules to create myriad Tao: in the Chaos Void, this might already qualify as having stepped into the Great Saint’s Domain.

“Hmm?”

“This floor is finished?”

Lin Yuan placed down the emerald-green leaf he had been examining, realizing that he’d exhausted all the inheritance scriptures surrounding him.

“Time to ascend to the thirteenth floor.”

Lin Yuan stood up. The Sky Burning Court consisted of thirteen floors, with each successive floor containing increasingly complex and profound inheritance texts.

Having already completed the previous twelve floors over the past year, Lin Yuan now sought to ascend to the thirteenth.

“One must fully comprehend all inheritance scriptures of the twelfth floor in order to access the thirteenth?” Gazing at the transparent barrier leading to the thirteenth floor, Lin Yuan smiled faintly.

In truth, not only did the twelfth floor require this condition for entry—all prior floors did as well.

Buzz!

Lin Yuan casually coalesced a strand of aura containing the essence of all the inheritance texts from the twelfth floor, effortlessly ascending to the thirteenth floor.

…

“The path of cultivation demands reverence.” Lord Qingfen opened his eyes, his gaze profound.

“That disciple of mine, after encountering the countless inheritance texts within the Sky Burning Court and gaining some understanding of this world, should have cultivated a sense of reverence by now.”

A smile appeared on Lord Qingfen’s face.

Lin Yuan’s talent was shockingly powerful—even Lord Qingfen admitted inferiority.

Yet no matter how strong a talent may be, it remains merely talent. To reach the pinnacle of cultivation, one must possess a heart brimming with reverence.

Therefore…

Upon bringing Lin Yuan to this place, Lord Qingfen had deliberately refrained from teaching him anything directly, instead throwing him straight into the Sky Burning Court.

Within it resided innumerable inheritance scriptures.

As long as Lin Yuan explored and read even a fraction of them, he would intuit the limitless wisdom and pathways embedded within.

The more he witnessed and understood, the more he would perceive his own insignificance. Wouldn’t such reverence naturally emerge in the process?

“Sky Burning Court…”

Lord Qingfen’s gaze fell upon the Sky Burning Court. Until now, he had intentionally avoided observing it to spare himself any embarrassment from seeing Lin Yuan potentially flustered and restless.

With a year’s worth of accumulation, the time was ripe for him to show up and offer guidance, instilling greater awareness in Lin Yuan of the vast heights and profound depths of the Tao.

Under Lord Qingfen’s gaze, the entirety of the Sky Burning Court came into view.

Yet for precisely this reason, upon seeing clearly inside the Sky Burning Court, Lord Qingfen instantly became somewhat stupefied.

“What is this?”
